caption: The drawing depicts a doll with a porcelain-like face featuring light skin, red cheeks, and dark painted hair parted in the middle. The doll is dressed in a long, full-sleeved dress that is light brown with pastel pink and blue streaks and patterns. The dress is adorned with white lace at the collar, sleeves, and two layers along the hem. There is a wide, blue-gray belt or sash at the waist. To the left and below the doll, there is a separate drawing of a small boot, brown and yellow in color, with a short heel. To the right and below the doll, there is a detailed depiction of the doll's underside or a mechanism showing two feet on a circular base. This part is colored in shades of tan, brown, and olive green, with some text inscribed around the circular edge. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Walking Doll
